#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure: ΔMH distribution with ETS A/B/C classification regions."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Serif',
    'font.size': 7,
    'axes.titlesize': 7.5,
    'axes.labelsize': 7,
    'xtick.labelsize': 6,
    'ytick.labelsize': 6,
    'legend.fontsize': 6,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

DATA_PATH = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520_2/projects/irt_equated_bench_regen/artifacts/plan_001_real_data_dif_mmlu/data/dif_results_temporal.csv'
OUT_DIR = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520_2/projects/irt_equated_bench_regen/figures/paper'

df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)
delta = df['delta_mh'].dropna().values

COL_A = '#4DAF4A'
COL_B = '#FF7F00'
COL_C = '#E41A1C'
COL_HIST = '#555555'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.25, 1.85))

bins = np.linspace(-8, 8, 81)
n, bin_edges, patches = ax.hist(delta, bins=bins, color=COL_HIST, alpha=0.75,
                                 edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3)

for patch, left, right in zip(patches, bin_edges[:-1], bin_edges[1:]):
    center = (left + right) / 2
    if abs(center) < 1.0:
        patch.set_facecolor(COL_A)
        patch.set_alpha(0.8)
    elif abs(center) < 1.5:
        patch.set_facecolor(COL_B)
        patch.set_alpha(0.8)
    else:
        patch.set_facecolor(COL_C)
        patch.set_alpha(0.8)

ymax = ax.get_ylim()[1]

for thresh in [-1.5, -1.0, 1.0, 1.5]:
    ls = '--' if abs(thresh) == 1.5 else ':'
    ax.axvline(thresh, color='#333333', linestyle=ls, linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.7)

ax.text(0, ymax * 0.92, 'A', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_A, alpha=0.9)
ax.text(1.25, ymax * 0.92, 'B', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_B, alpha=0.9)
ax.text(-1.25, ymax * 0.92, 'B', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_B, alpha=0.9)
ax.text(3.5, ymax * 0.92, 'C', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_C, alpha=0.9)
ax.text(-3.5, ymax * 0.92, 'C', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=COL_C, alpha=0.9)

n_total = len(delta)
n_a = np.sum(df['ets_class'] == 'A')
n_b = np.sum(df['ets_class'] == 'B')
n_c = np.sum(df['ets_class'] == 'C')
pct_a = 100 * n_a / n_total
pct_b = 100 * n_b / n_total
pct_c = 100 * n_c / n_total

patch_a = mpatches.Patch(color=COL_A, alpha=0.8, label=f'A: {pct_a:.1f}%')
patch_b = mpatches.Patch(color=COL_B, alpha=0.8, label=f'B: {pct_b:.1f}%')
patch_c = mpatches.Patch(color=COL_C, alpha=0.8, label=f'C: {pct_c:.1f}%')
ax.legend(handles=[patch_a, patch_b, patch_c], loc='upper right',
          frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc',
          handlelength=1.0, handletextpad=0.4, borderpad=0.3)

ax.set_xlabel(r'$\Delta_{\mathrm{MH}}$')
ax.set_ylabel('Number of items')
ax.set_xlim(-8, 8)

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
plt.savefig(f'{OUT_DIR}/fig_ets_distribution.pdf')
plt.savefig(f'{OUT_DIR}/fig_ets_distribution.png')
print(f'A: {n_a} ({pct_a:.1f}%), B: {n_b} ({pct_b:.1f}%), C: {n_c} ({pct_c:.1f}%)')
print(f'Total: {n_total}')
print('Saved to fig_ets_distribution.pdf')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure 0: Four-stage psychometric auditing pipeline."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 7,
    'axes.titlesize': 7.5,
    'axes.labelsize': 6.5,
    'xtick.labelsize': 5.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 5.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 5.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

OUTDIR = Path(__file__).parent
STEM = 'fig_0_pipeline'

COL_REF = '#0072B2'
COL_FOCAL = '#D55E00'
COL_A = '#4DAF4A'
COL_B = '#FF7F00'
COL_C = '#E41A1C'
COL_BG = '#F7F7F7'
COL_BORDER = '#CCCCCC'

DING = lambda n: chr(0x2460 + n - 1)  # ①②③④

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 3.8))

# Main layout: 4 panels with arrows between them
# Give right panels more relative space
gs_main = gridspec.GridSpec(1, 4, figure=fig,
                            width_ratios=[1.0, 1.0, 1.1, 1.1],
                            wspace=0.28)

# ====== PANEL 1: Response Matrix ======
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[0, 0])

np.random.seed(42)
n_models, n_items = 20, 25
matrix = np.random.binomial(1, 0.55, size=(n_models, n_items)).astype(float)
# Make top rows (2023) slightly different from bottom rows (2024)
matrix[:10, :] = np.random.binomial(1, 0.50, size=(10, n_items))
matrix[10:, :] = np.random.binomial(1, 0.60, size=(10, n_items))

cmap = plt.cm.colors.ListedColormap(['#E8E8E8', '#2C7BB6'])
ax1.imshow(matrix, cmap=cmap, aspect='auto', interpolation='nearest')

ax1.axhline(9.5, color='white', linewidth=2.0)
ax1.text(-0.5, 4.5, '2023\ncohort', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=5.5,
         color=COL_REF, fontweight='bold', transform=ax1.transData)
ax1.text(-0.5, 14.5, '2024\ncohort', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=5.5,
         color=COL_FOCAL, fontweight='bold', transform=ax1.transData)

ax1.set_xticks([])
ax1.set_yticks([])
ax1.set_xlabel('12,508 items', fontsize=6)
ax1.set_ylabel('5,227 models', fontsize=6)
ax1.set_title(f'{DING(1)} Response Matrix', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', pad=6)

for spine in ax1.spines.values():
    spine.set_edgecolor(COL_BORDER)
    spine.set_linewidth(0.8)
    spine.set_visible(True)

# ====== PANEL 2: Score Stratification ======
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[0, 1])

np.random.seed(123)
n_pts = 80
scores = np.random.beta(2.5, 2.5, n_pts)
quintiles = np.digitize(scores, np.quantile(scores, [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8]))
q_colors = ['#d73027', '#fc8d59', '#fee090', '#91bfdb', '#4575b4']
q_labels = ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5']

x_jitter = np.random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3, n_pts)
for q in range(5):
    mask = quintiles == q
    ax2.scatter(x_jitter[mask], scores[mask], c=q_colors[q], s=12, alpha=0.7,
                edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.3, zorder=3)

# Draw quintile boundaries
for qval in np.quantile(scores, [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8]):
    ax2.axhline(qval, color='#999999', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.6)

# Q labels on right
q_bounds = [0] + list(np.quantile(scores, [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8])) + [1]
for i in range(5):
    mid = (q_bounds[i] + q_bounds[i+1]) / 2
    ax2.text(0.5, mid, q_labels[i], ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6,
             fontweight='bold', color=q_colors[i], alpha=0.8)

ax2.set_xlim(-0.6, 0.6)
ax2.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.02)
ax2.set_xticks([])

ax3.set_ylim(0, 10)
ax3.axis('off')

# 2×2 contingency table
table_x, table_y = 1.0, 5.8
cell_w, cell_h = 2.8, 1.3

# Headers
ax3.text(table_x + cell_w, table_y + cell_h + 0.3, 'Correct', ha='center', va='bottom',

ax3.text(table_x + 2*cell_w, table_y + cell_h + 0.3, 'Incorrect', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=6, fontweight='bold', color='#444444')
ax3.text(table_x - 0.2, table_y + cell_h/2, 'Ref.', ha='right', va='center',
         fontsize=6, fontweight='bold', color=COL_REF)
ax3.text(table_x - 0.2, table_y - cell_h/2, 'Focal', ha='right', va='center',
         fontsize=6, fontweight='bold', color=COL_FOCAL)

# Grid
for row in range(3):
    y = table_y + cell_h - row * cell_h
    ax3.plot([table_x, table_x + 2*cell_w], [y, y], color='#AAAAAA', linewidth=0.7)
for col in range(3):
    x = table_x + col * cell_w
    ax3.plot([x, x], [table_y - cell_h, table_y + cell_h], color='#AAAAAA', linewidth=0.7)

# Cell values
cells = [['$A_k$', '$B_k$'], ['$C_k$', '$D_k$']]
for r in range(2):
    for c in range(2):
        cx = table_x + (c + 0.5) * cell_w
        cy = table_y + (0.5 - r) * cell_h
        ax3.text(cx, cy, cells[r][c], ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8,
                 color='#333333', style='italic')

# Formula
ax3.text(5.0, 3.2,
         r'$\alpha_{\mathrm{MH}} = \frac{\sum A_k D_k / T_k}{\sum B_k C_k / T_k}$',
         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='#333333')

ax3.text(5.0, 1.5,
         r'$\Delta_{\mathrm{MH}} = -2.35\,\ln(\alpha_{\mathrm{MH}})$',
         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#333333')

ax3.text(5.0, 0.5, r'$\times\,K$ strata, per item',
         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.5, color='#888888')

# ETS bar chart visual
bar_y = 6.5
bar_h = 2.2
# A region: 0 to 1.0

              boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', facecolor=COL_A, alpha=0.3, edgecolor=COL_A, linewidth=0.8))
ax4.text(1.55, bar_y + bar_h/2, 'A\nnegligible', ha='center', va='center',

# B region: 1.0 to 1.5

ax4.text(3.85, bar_y + bar_h/2, 'B\nmod.', ha='center', va='center',

# C region: ≥ 1.5

ax4.text(3.1, bar_y - 0.4, '1.0', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=5.5, color='#666666')

for i, (main_text, sub_text) in enumerate(results):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure 5: Cross-subject vs within-subject matching — scatter plot."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Serif',
    'font.size': 7,
    'axes.titlesize': 8,
    'axes.labelsize': 7,
    'xtick.labelsize': 6,
    'ytick.labelsize': 6,
    'legend.fontsize': 6,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.2,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

C_CROSS = '#0072B2'
C_WITHIN = '#D55E00'

csv_path = (
    '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520_2/projects/irt_equated_bench_regen'
    '/artifacts/plan_016_within_subject_semi_synthetic/data'
    '/within_subject_dose_response_e6d86f.csv'
)
df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

df_p0 = df[df['p'] == 0.0]
df_p5 = df[df['p'] == 0.5]

records = []
for subj in df['subject'].unique():
    for mt in ['cross', 'within']:
        row_p0 = df_p0[(df_p0['subject'] == subj) & (df_p0['matching_type'] == mt)].iloc[0]
        row_p5 = df_p5[(df_p5['subject'] == subj) & (df_p5['matching_type'] == mt)].iloc[0]
        records.append({
            'subject': subj,
            'matching_type': mt,
            'delta_tpr': row_p5['delta_tpr'],
            'delta_fpr': row_p5['fpr_mean'] - row_p0['fpr_mean'],
        })

data = pd.DataFrame(records)

label_map = {
    'business_ethics': 'Bus. Ethics',
    'human_aging': 'Human Aging',
    'professional_medicine': 'Prof. Med.',
    'formal_logic': 'Formal Logic',
    'high_school_statistics': 'HS Stats',
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.25, 2.4))

# ΔFPR = 0 ideal line
ax.axhline(0, color='#999999', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.6, zorder=0)

# Draw arrows from cross to within for each subject
for subj in data['subject'].unique():
    cross = data[(data['subject'] == subj) & (data['matching_type'] == 'cross')]
    within = data[(data['subject'] == subj) & (data['matching_type'] == 'within')]

    cx, cy = cross['delta_tpr'].values[0], cross['delta_fpr'].values[0]
    wx, wy = within['delta_tpr'].values[0], within['delta_fpr'].values[0]

    ax.annotate('', xy=(wx, wy), xytext=(cx, cy),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#BBBBBB', lw=0.8,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.05'),
                zorder=1)

# Plot points
for subj in data['subject'].unique():
    cross = data[(data['subject'] == subj) & (data['matching_type'] == 'cross')]
    within = data[(data['subject'] == subj) & (data['matching_type'] == 'within')]

    ax.scatter(cross['delta_tpr'], cross['delta_fpr'],
               color=C_CROSS, s=35, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.5)
    ax.scatter(within['delta_tpr'], within['delta_fpr'],
               facecolors='white', edgecolors=C_WITHIN, s=35, zorder=3, linewidths=1.2)

    # Label subjects near within-subject points (higher FPR, more visible)
    wx, wy = within['delta_tpr'].values[0], within['delta_fpr'].values[0]
    lbl = label_map.get(subj, subj)

    # Offset labels to avoid overlap
    offset_x, offset_y = 0.02, 0.006
    ha = 'left'
    if subj == 'formal_logic':
        offset_x, offset_y = 0.02, -0.008
        ha = 'left'
    elif subj == 'business_ethics':
        offset_x, offset_y = -0.02, 0.006
        ha = 'right'
    elif subj == 'human_aging':
        offset_x, offset_y = 0.02, -0.008
        ha = 'left'

    ax.text(wx + offset_x, wy + offset_y, lbl, fontsize=5.5, color='#555555',
            ha=ha, va='center')

# Shade the "ideal" region
ax.axhspan(-0.005, 0.005, color=C_CROSS, alpha=0.06, zorder=0)
ax.text(0.02, 0.003, r'$\Delta$FPR $\approx$ 0 (ideal)', fontsize=5.5,
        color=C_CROSS, alpha=0.7, va='bottom')

# Legend
ax.scatter([], [], color=C_CROSS, s=30, label='Cross-subject')
ax.scatter([], [], facecolors='white', edgecolors=C_WITHIN, s=30,
           linewidths=1.2, label='Within-subject')
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc',
          handletextpad=0.3, borderpad=0.3)

ax.set_xlabel(r'$\Delta$TPR  (detection power at $p = 0.5$)')
ax.set_ylabel(r'$\Delta$FPR  (false positive inflation)')

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)

out_dir = (
    '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520_2/projects/irt_equated_bench_regen'
    '/figures/paper'
)
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_3_within_subject_matching.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_3_within_subject_matching.png')
print(f'Saved to {out_dir}')
plt.close()
